name: cosign
description: Container image signing and verification tool with keyless signing and OIDC support

cosign.description: Container signing, verification and storage in OCI registry with keyless authentication and policy enforcement
cosign.usage:
cosign sign --yes myimage:latest
cosign verify --key cosign.pub myimage:latest
cosign verify-attestation --key cosign.pub --type slsaprovenance myimage:latest
cosign generate-key-pair
cosign triangulate myimage:latest
